Looking closely, you're traveling
with a lot of Blades.

rows.label: tlk43300011_04_msg0002
rows.name:
If you have more Blades than you can
handle, why not send some on a
Merc Mission?

rows.label: tlk43300011_04_msg0003

There's plenty of folks in town
who'd appreciate a helping hand.

rows.label: tlk43300011_04_msg0004
rows.name:
You get rewards and experience too...
Two birds with one stone.
